{
  "observation": "I touched the blue cube after the person set the pencil down. It said “Work is complete.” Later, the person touched the cube while the pencil was still on the paper, and it repeated the message.",
  "interpretation": "They may have wanted to hear the update while working or may simply have wanted to replay it.",
  "title": "Timing of spoken updates",
  "note": "The person used the blue cube to replay a completion update during a writing task. Their preferred timing for future updates is unclear.",
  "question": "For future low-priority updates, should I speak while you’re working or wait until you pause?"
}
